overview: A fun, virtual-only money app where friends send each other fake rupees with funny notes, soundbox voice alerts, custom cards, and a leaderboard.
features: Sign-up onboarding with name, class and section, roll number, and Instagram ID
Virtual wallet with a custom starting fake balance
Add friends by username or QR code
Send and request fake money with fun notes
Cash-register sound and voice announcement on receiving money
Custom virtual debit card creator with neon styles and stickers
Dark glassmorphism design with confetti and a fake-money leaderboard
